#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Separate-worker saturation slot screen, with bounded independent profiles."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

REPO=Path('/home/will/wk/exp/ferrum');ROOT=Path('/tmp/ferrum-saturation-slots-dd263e8');OUT=ROOT/'experiment'
sys.path.insert(0,str(REPO/'tools/performance/smt'))
from run_saturation import check_outcome,sha,trial,write

OUT.mkdir()
spec=json.loads(Path('/tmp/ferrum-method-saturation-dd263e8/experiment/spec.json').read_text())
spec['kind']='separate-worker-saturation-slots-v1'
spec['source_head']=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=REPO,text=True).strip()
spec['profiles']={name:{'weights':weights,'options':['--separateMethodSolver=true']} for name,weights in [
 ('current','[1,0.5,0.4,0,0]'),('inhale_only','[1,0.5,0.4,0.2,0]'),('repetition_only','[1,0.5,0.4,0,0.02]')]}
profiles=list(spec['profiles']);mirrored=profiles+list(reversed(profiles))
for case in spec['cases']:case['profiles']=profiles
spec['host']['load']=Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text().strip()
spec['limits']=['Same separate solver, one worker, branches off, internal caches on and existing development binaries.',
 'Only the inhale and repetition saturation slots change; base 100ms and first three weights fixed.',
 'Two array controls per profile, then mirrored nested captures and mirrored untraced timings for both positive cases.',
 'A new-profile nested verifier timeout is retained and skips its remaining captures/timings while independent profiles continue.',
 'Control/baseline failures, other protocol/outcome failures and unequal repeat signatures stop the screen.',
 '60s program / 90s outer / 45s offline limits; no retries, budget increases or rerun of the already timed-out combined profile.',
 'Shared-host elapsed times remain noisy; all solver work includes owner and worker.']
prior_path=Path('/tmp/ferrum-method-solver-235b245/experiment/trials.jsonl')
prior={(r['case']):r for line in prior_path.read_text().splitlines() for r in [json.loads(line)] if r['profile']=='separate'}
paths=[spec['z3'],spec['proxy'],spec['supervisor'],*spec['commands']['ferrum'],spec['phase_command'],
 *(c['path'] for c in spec['cases']),str(Path(__file__).resolve()),str(prior_path),
 str(REPO/'crates/ferrum-silicon/src/config.rs'),str(REPO/'src/lib.rs'),
 str(REPO/'tools/performance/smt/run_saturation.py'),str(REPO/'tools/performance/smt/analyze_trace.py')]
spec['artifact_sha256']={p:sha(p) for p in paths}
schedule=[]
for case in ['mut_element_array_wrong','mut_element_array_pass','mut_element_nested_pass']:
 for profile in mirrored if case=='mut_element_nested_pass' else profiles:
  schedule.append({'index':len(schedule),'case':case,'profile':profile,'backend':'ferrum',
   'repetition':sum(r['case']==case and r['profile']==profile for r in schedule),'control':case!='mut_element_nested_pass'})
phase_schedule=[{'index':i,'case':case,'profile':profile} for i,(case,profile) in enumerate(
 (case,profile) for case in ['mut_element_nested_pass','mut_element_array_pass'] for profile in mirrored)]
write(OUT/'spec.json',spec);write(OUT/'schedule.json',schedule);write(OUT/'phase-schedule.json',phase_schedule)
start=time.monotonic();rows=[];gates=[];phases=[];skipped=[];excluded=set()
captures=OUT/'captures';captures.mkdir()
def signature(r):
 return sorted((t['input_sha256'],t['output_sha256'],t['query_count'],t['offline']['statistics'].get('quant-instantiations','0'),t['offline']['statistics'].get('rlimit-count','0')) for t in r['traces'])
def finish(status,reason=None):
 postflight=[p for p,h in spec['artifact_sha256'].items() if sha(p)!=h]
 summary={'status':status,'reason':reason,'gates':gates,'timings':phases,'excluded_profiles':sorted(excluded),'skipped':skipped,
  'elapsed_s':time.monotonic()-start,'postflight_errors':postflight}
 write(OUT/'summary.json',summary)
 print('SUMMARY',status,summary['elapsed_s'],'excluded',sorted(excluded),'postflight',postflight,flush=True)
 return summary
def stop(reason):
 finish('stopped',reason);raise SystemExit(reason)
for row in schedule:
 if row['profile'] in excluded:
  skipped.append({'stage':'capture',**row,'reason':'Profile already hit the verifier timeout.'});write(OUT/'skipped.json',skipped);continue
 settings={**spec,'options':[*spec['options'],*spec['profiles'][row['profile']]['options']]}
 result=trial(settings,row,captures);rows.append(result)
 with (OUT/'trials.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(result)+'\n')
 session=json.loads((Path(result['folder'])/'session.json').read_text())
 timeout=(session['outcome']=='completed' and not session['cleanup_pending'] and not session['protocol_errors'] and
  len(session['records'])==1 and session['records'][0]['outcome']=='verifier_timeout' and
  [e['id'] for e in session['records'][0]['errors']]==['timeout.error'])
 gate={'index':row['index'],'valid':result['valid'],'stream_count':len(result['traces']),'bounded_timeout':timeout,'checks':{}}
 if not row['control'] and row['profile']!='current' and timeout:
  excluded.add(row['profile']);gate['action']='exclude_after_timeout';gates.append(gate);write(OUT/'gates.json',gates)
  print('EXCLUDE',row['profile'],'after bounded timeout; continuing independent profiles',flush=True);continue
 gate['checks']={'expected_outcome_and_replay':result['valid'],'expected_stream_count':len(result['traces'])==2}
 if result['valid']:
  if row['profile']=='current':gate['checks']['prior_current_equal']=signature(result)==signature(prior[row['case']])
  repeats=[r for r in rows[:-1] if r['case']==row['case'] and r['profile']==row['profile']]
  if repeats:gate['checks']['repeat_signature_equal']=signature(result)==signature(repeats[0])
 gate['action']='continue' if all(gate['checks'].values()) else 'stop';gates.append(gate);write(OUT/'gates.json',gates)
 print('GATE',json.dumps(gate),flush=True)
 if gate['action']=='stop':stop('Control, outcome, protocol or reproducibility gate failed.')
for row in phase_schedule:
 if row['profile'] in excluded:
  skipped.append({'stage':'phase',**row,'reason':'Profile already hit the verifier timeout.'});write(OUT/'skipped.json',skipped);continue
 case=next(c for c in spec['cases'] if c['name']==row['case']);p=spec['profiles'][row['profile']]
 folder=OUT/f"phase-{row['index']:02d}-{row['case']}-{row['profile']}";folder.mkdir()
 command=['taskset','--cpu-list',spec['cpu_affinity'],spec['phase_command'],spec['z3'],*spec['options'],*p['options'],
  '--parallelizeBranches=false','--proverSaturationTimeout','100','--proverSaturationTimeoutWeights',p['weights'],'--',case['path']]
 supervisor=[sys.executable,spec['supervisor'],'--timeout',str(spec['outer_timeout']),'--output',str(folder/'session.json'),'--',*command]
 print('PHASE START',row['index'],row['case'],row['profile'],flush=True)
 load=Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text().strip()
 proc=subprocess.run(supervisor,env={**os.environ,'FERRUM_BENCH_INTERNAL_CACHES':'on'},capture_output=True,text=True)
 (folder/'supervisor.log').write_text(proc.stdout+proc.stderr);session=json.loads((folder/'session.json').read_text())
 spans=[json.loads(line[len('@@PERF@@'):]) for line in session['raw_output'].splitlines() if line.startswith('@@PERF@@')]
 record={**row,'command':command,'session':str(folder/'session.json'),'wall_s':session['wall_seconds'],
  'phase_s':{p['phase']:int(p['elapsed_ns'])/1e9 for p in spans},'load_before':load,
  'load_after':Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text().strip(),'valid':proc.returncode==0 and check_outcome(session,case)}
 phases.append(record);write(OUT/'timings.json',phases)
 print('PHASE FINISH',row['case'],row['profile'],record['valid'],'wall',record['wall_s'],'verify',record['phase_s'].get('session_verify_inclusive'),flush=True)
 if not record['valid'] or 'session_verify_inclusive' not in record['phase_s']:stop('Invalid phase timing; no retry.')
summary=finish('completed_with_timeout_exclusions' if excluded else 'completed')
raise SystemExit(bool(summary['postflight_errors']))

"""Match the five prior slow checks; retain missing matches and context differences."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

ROOT=Path('/tmp/ferrum-saturation-slots-dd263e8');RUN=ROOT/'experiment'
old=json.loads(Path('/tmp/ferrum-method-saturation-dd263e8/slow-query-matches.json').read_text())
targets={p['current']['assertion']:p for p in old['pairs']}
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in (RUN/'trials.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
streams=[{'profile':r['profile'],'index':r['index'],'trial':r['folder'],'folder':max(r['traces'],key=lambda t:t['query_count'])['folder']} for r in rows if r['case']=='mut_element_nested_pass' and r['repetition']==0]
streams.append({'profile':'both_historical','index':None,'trial':str(Path(old['streams'][1]).parent.parent),'folder':old['streams'][1]})
records=[]
for stream in streams:
 folder=Path(stream['folder']);a=json.loads((folder/'analysis.json').read_text());data=(folder/'stdin.bin').read_bytes()
 qs={q['index']:q for q in a['queries']};opts={};core=hashlib.sha256();count=0;matches=[]
 for c in a['commands']:
  if c['name']=='set-option':
   m=re.match(r'\( set-option :(\S+) (.*?) \)',c['preview'])
   if m:opts[m[1]]=m[2]
  omit=c['name']=='check-sat' or (c['name']=='set-option' and c['preview'].startswith('( set-option :rlimit '))
  if not omit:
   core.update((c['canonical_sha256']+'\n').encode());count+=1
  if c['name']!='check-sat':continue
  prev=a['commands'][c['index']-1]
  if prev['name']!='assert' or prev['canonical_sha256'] not in targets:continue
  q=qs[c['index']];raw=data[prev['start']:prev['end']]
  matches.append({'target':prev['canonical_sha256'],'query_index':c['index'],'assertion_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
   'options':dict(opts),'response':q.get('response'),'wait_s':q.get('response_wait_s'),
   'core_prefix_sha256':core.hexdigest(),'core_command_count':count})
 records.append({**stream,'matches':matches,'missing_targets':sorted(set(targets)-{m['target'] for m in matches}), 'full_core_sha256':core.hexdigest(),'full_core_command_count':count})
base={m['target']:m for m in next(r for r in records if r['profile']=='current')['matches']}
for r in records:
 for m in r['matches']:
  b=base[m['target']]
  m.update(assertion_bytes_equal=m['assertion_sha256']==b['assertion_sha256'],options_equal=m['options']==b['options'],
   core_prefix_equal=m['core_prefix_sha256']==b['core_prefix_sha256'])
report={'removed_commands':['check-sat','set-option :rlimit'],
 'scope':'Core-prefix equality preserves every other command in order, including assertions, declarations, push/pop and other options. It is a command-sequence comparison, not equivalence of solver search state.',
 'historical_source':'/tmp/ferrum-method-saturation-dd263e8/slow-query-matches.json','streams':records}
(ROOT/'query-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
for r in records:
 print(r['profile'],'matches',len(r['matches']),'missing',len(r['missing_targets']),'waits',[m['wait_s'] for m in r['matches']], 'core_equal',[m['core_prefix_equal'] for m in r['matches']])
limits: Same existing development build on a shared laptop; two nested captures and two untraced timing observations per successful setting.
The both-enabled timeout is historical, not rerun or timed as part of this screen.
Core-prefix comparison omits check-sat and set-option :rlimit only; it does not equate the internal search states.
No runtime or default changes, new full Rust matrix, or fresh direct-Prusti end-to-end measurements.
Offline CPU is measured in a separate fixed-stream replay; inclusive wall phases must not be subtracted to infer native-only time.
